raz fresco.bio: Toronto-born, Brampton-raised rapper and producer Raz Fresco is a Canadian hip-hop artist known for sample-heavy production, dense lyricism and his Bakers Club collective.

remy shand.bio: Winnipeg singer-songwriter, producer and multi-instrumentalist Remy Shand is a Canadian neo-soul artist whose 2002 album The Way I Feel earned major chart success and four Grammy nominations.

ria mae.bio: Halifax singer-songwriter Ria Mae is a Canadian pop artist known for emotionally direct writing, guitar-led songwriting and radio hits that bridge indie pop and mainstream pop.

rochelle jordan.bio: Toronto-raised singer Rochelle Jordan blends futuristic R&B with house, garage, electronic pop and hip-hop influences in a sleek, club-informed catalogue.

roy woods.bio: Brampton-born singer, rapper and songwriter Roy Woods blends R&B, hip-hop and trap and became one of the early Canadian artists signed to Drake's OVO Sound label.

ruth b..bio: Edmonton singer-songwriter Ruth B. is a Canadian pop artist whose career grew from short-form social media performances into the multi-platinum breakout single Lost Boy and a Juno Award.

said the whale.bio: Vancouver indie-rock band Said the Whale combines melodic guitar pop, indie folk and distinctly West Coast songwriting in a long-running Canadian catalogue.

sam roberts.bio: Montréal singer-songwriter Sam Roberts is a Juno-winning Canadian rock artist known for melodic, guitar-driven songs including Brother Down and Don't Walk Away Eileen.

sarah harmer.bio: Burlington-born singer-songwriter Sarah Harmer is a Canadian folk, pop and rock artist known for warm vocals, thoughtful songwriting and environmental advocacy.

saukrates.bio: Toronto-based rapper, producer and singer Saukrates is a foundational Canadian hip-hop artist whose career spans underground rap, R&B, production and the group Big Black Lincoln.

savannah ré.bio: Scarborough R&B singer-songwriter Savannah Ré is a multi-Juno-winning Canadian artist known for intimate, emotionally candid songwriting and collaborations across contemporary R&B.

saya gray.bio: Toronto-born multi-instrumentalist Saya Gray is a Canadian experimental pop artist whose music blends alternative pop, R&B, jazz-trained musicianship and densely layered production.

scott helman.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter Scott Helman is a Canadian pop artist who began releasing music as a teenager and built a national audience around melodic, guitar-driven songwriting.

sean leon.bio: Toronto rapper, singer and producer Sean Leon is a Canadian hip-hop artist and founder of the IXXI Initiative, known for experimental solo work and songwriting collaborations.

serena ryder.bio: Ontario singer-songwriter Serena Ryder is a multi-Juno-winning Canadian artist known for a powerful voice and music spanning folk, rock, soul and pop.

sloan.bio: Halifax-formed rock band Sloan is one of Canada's longest-running alternative and power-pop groups, notable for its unchanged four-member lineup and shared songwriting and lead vocals.

swollen members.bio: Vancouver group Swollen Members is a four-time Juno-winning Canadian hip-hop act built around rappers Madchild and Prevail with producer Rob the Viking.
